class: package-lock.json out of sync with package.json
commitMessage: Pad article numbers and cap slug length

expect.logRegex: `npm ci` can only install packages when your package\.json and package-lock\.json

decoys.note: Deletes the lockfile; npm ci needs one.
Reverts package.json to the locked acme-slug 1.0.0, which is not vendored.

notes: package.json moved to acme-slug 1.1.0 and added acme-pad, but package-lock.json still records acme-slug 1.0.0 and lacks acme-pad. Both packages are vendored tarballs, so npm install --package-lock-only regenerates the lock offline.
